Maker Format:
Ace
Makers I Own:
Ace, MZ
Art Style:
Can be RTP style or original
Description:
I have a Werewolf character, and I’d like to build his combat style around claw and bite attacks. Unfortunately, I haven’t been able to find any suitable animations for these types of attacks.
I’m specifically looking for animations that represent claw slashes and bite attacks that would fit RPG Maker Ace. RTP style would be ideal, but original styles are also welcome.
Any help, recommendations, or existing resources would be appreciated.

posts.author: Avery
posts.body:
If you can see the gifs, you can turn those into animations. (Seems like the download didn't work for me either here, weird, cause I downloaded something different from there just a week ago)
All you need is a sheet that is 5x192 px wide and has as many rows as you need. Then you save the gif and drag it into your sheet.
It will look something like this, each frame in the gif is a layer.
Sort them into your sheet (you can enable snapping so they all slot into the same position), and after sorting it should look something like this:
Repeat for the other two now that you are at it. (I switched to a 96x96 grid here so I could use the "center" of 4 tiles as guide for my animation frames)
Looks like this now:
Merge all on one layer and use colors - color to alpha and choose black. Ta-daa.
Since pipoya is good with edits, this is no problem.
Here are their terms.
Translated Terms of Usage of Japanese blogs
